parent_result.note: Both hits replayed and fit the certificate limit; neither is counted as official or promoted yet.

target: Distinguish a production budget threshold from nondeterminism or surface dependence, and verify every reconstructed certificate with the official local Lean judge.

live_rivals.H_budget_threshold: The production-equivalent 3-second compact budget misses while the existing 5-second configuration reliably succeeds.
live_rivals.H_timing_instability: The apparent gain is a wall-clock threshold artifact that is not reliable across repetitions.
live_rivals.H_surface_dependence: The route relies on variable names or left/right operation presentation.
live_rivals.H_constructor_language: Internal replay succeeds but Lean rejects the emitted certificate.

controls.same_route_and_limits: COMPACT_SUPERPOSITION_FAST; only seconds and semantics-preserving presentation change

outcome_to_action.three_second_fail_five_second_stable: Treat as a scheduling/budget mechanism; retain evidence but do not promote until cross-family transfer and soundness/full regression gates pass.
outcome_to_action.unstable_original: Reject a fixed 5-second promotion and map timing sensitivity.
outcome_to_action.lean_rejection: Diagnose constructor/language and repair emission only.
outcome_to_action.all_checks_pass: Seek an independent normal-family or protected transfer before promotion; do not weaken the preregistered family gate.
